HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
ORDER
Imphal, the 22m July, 2026
No. HCM/J-11/2013 -A&E (Pt. I)/ Hon’ble The Chief Justice, High Court
of Manipur is pleased to appoint Shri Laikhuram Surchandra Singh, former Deputy Registrar
(Adam.), High Court of Manipur as Deputy Director of Manipur Judicial Academy,
temporarily for the period from the date he assumes charge until 28.02.2027 against the post
of Deputy Director created vide order No. L-MISC-503/5/2023-SEC-LAW dated lst October,
2025 and extended vide letter No. JudI.-1/18/2021-SEC-LAW dated 26th February, 2026 of the
Secretariat: Law & Legislative Affairs Department, Government ofManipur.
He is entitled to draw a monthly salary of last pay drawn minus pension. His monthly
pay would be debitable to the Major Head 2014-Administrative of Justice (Non-Plan), Sub
Major 00, Minor 102-High Court of Manipur (charged), Sub-Head 01-High Court of Manipur,
Detailed 03-Manipur Judicial Academy, Object 01-Salaries under Grant No. 26-
Administration of Justice for the year 2026-2027.
By Order, etc.
Sd/-
(OJESH MUTUM)
REGISTRAR GENERAL
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Endt. No. HCM/J-11/2013-A&E (Pt.1)/ /6 O 88 - 95
